provenance.equation: Driven canonical theta flow dtheta/dt=(1-cos(theta))+(1+cos(theta))*gain*I, independently re-derived from Ermentrout and Kopell (1986), is advanced with the maintained forward-Euler parameter dt=0.1. Each unwrapped candidate is tested for an upward theta=pi crossing before the committed phase is reduced modulo 2*pi. The schema runner uses method=map and protocol dt=1 because its dynamics string already contains that complete Euler recurrence.
